mapper.sql: SELECT uc.concept_id FROM user_concepts uc WHERE uc.user_id = CAST(#{userId} AS uuid) AND uc.total > 0
mapper.select: SELECT c.id, c.name, c.theme, uc.correct, uc.total FROM user_concepts uc JOIN concepts c ON c.id = uc.concept_id WHERE uc.user_id = CAST(#{userId} AS uuid) AND uc.total > 0 ORDER BY c.id
SELECT e.from_concept, e.to_concept, e.force_dir FROM causal_edges e WHERE e.from_concept IN () OR e.to_concept IN () ORDER BY e.id
SELECT c.id, c.name, c.theme, 0 AS correct, 0 AS total FROM concepts c WHERE c.id IN #{id} ORDER BY c.id
SELECT DISTINCT (ua.created_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul')::date AS day FROM user_answers ua WHERE ua.user_id = CAST(#{userId} AS uuid) ORDER BY day DESC LIMIT 400

SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE ua.is_correct IS NOT NULL) AS graded, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE ua.is_correct) AS correct, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE s.kind = 'judgement') AS judgements FROM user_answers ua JOIN steps s ON s.id = ua.step_id WHERE ua.user_id = CAST(#{userId} AS uuid)

SELECT l.day, l.card_id::text AS card_id, c.title, c.card_date, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM steps s WHERE s.card_id = c.id AND s.kind <> 'concept') AS step_count, COUNT(*) AS answered, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE l.is_correct IS NOT NULL) AS graded, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE l.is_correct) AS correct FROM (SELECT DISTINCT ON (day, ua.step_id) (ua.created_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul')::date AS day, ua.card_id, ua.step_id, ua.is_correct, ua.created_at FROM user_answers ua WHERE ua.user_id = CAST(#{userId} AS uuid) AND ua.created_at >= now() - INTERVAL '400 days' ORDER BY day, ua.step_id, ua.created_at DESC) l JOIN cards c ON c.id = l.card_id GROUP BY l.day, l.card_id, c.id, c.title, c.card_date ORDER BY l.day DESC, MIN(l.created_at)
